assembly:001/space:011.name: arrival_yard
assembly:001/space:011.basis: holds the only player start; 478 player areas; every sector sky-lit; 42 sprites; the outdoor tile set (wall 2499, floor 2448, ceiling 2500)

assembly:001/space:028.name: main_open_ground
assembly:001/space:028.basis: largest space at 873 player areas; 9 of 15 sectors sky-lit; outdoor tile set; the only space touching both a second exterior and the big interior

assembly:001/space:063.name: far_open_ground
assembly:001/space:063.basis: 820 player areas, 16 of 16 sectors sky-lit, outdoor tile set, but connected only to two small spaces -- a separate outdoor lobe

assembly:001/space:037.name: large_interior
assembly:001/space:037.basis: 475 player areas with no sky at all; its own tile set (wall 153/181, floor 253/21, ceiling 20/67); 27 sectors, 54 sprites -- the densest space in the map; contains a stepped run, a recess and three shells

assembly:001/space:027.name: shell_court
assembly:001/space:027.basis: 430 player areas, 4 sky sectors, three embedded shells and one recess; a third tile set again (wall 309/355, floor 2490/355)

assembly:001/space:033.name: second_interior
assembly:001/space:033.basis: 258 player areas, no sky, 7.3 player heights, wall 309/5 over floor 365/6

assembly:001/space:050.name: outdoor_junction
assembly:001/space:050.basis: 248 player areas, 11 of 11 sectors sky-lit, and the only space adjacent to three other major spaces

assembly:001/space:044.name: sprite_dense_interior
assembly:001/space:044.basis: 233 player areas, no sky, 40 sprites, and a tile set (365/372) it shares with nothing else; what it is for is not measured here

assembly:001.name: main_complex
assembly:001.basis: the single navigation component holding 327 of the level's 340 sectors
